github.description: InterPSS Agentic Power System Simulation Agent for AC load flow, DC-based contingency analysis, and NERC TPL style reporting. This repository ships agent-facing skills. It is also integrated into Deepseek Harness as a DSH Plugin. You can run power system simulations in the traditional way in a local sandbox or in the native AI env.
